name: blonde-curly-hair-beige-tank-top-selfie
image_purpose: Bathroom outfit selfie and lifestyle feed post

prompt.project_info: Create a high-resolution mobile mirror selfie in a modern neutral-toned bathroom.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with long voluminous blonde curly hair, natural skin texture, and a subtle pout. She wears a beige ribbed cropped tank top and dark high-waisted leggings, holding a modern smartphone in a waist-up mirror reflection.
prompt.composition_elements: 5:6 waist-up mirror selfie with the subject centered and a gently softened background. Include neutral tiled walls, chrome wall-mounted towel radiator, white porcelain sink in the foreground, and an open doorway showing a hallway.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft overhead indoor lighting with natural skin tones, warm beige and cream palette, charcoal accents, gentle realistic shadows and modern bathroom calm.
prompt.technical_specs: High-resolution mobile photography, 5:6 portrait framing, realistic hair definition and skin pores, slight background focus falloff, subtle digital grain, natural color.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A high-resolution 5:6 mobile mirror selfie of one approved adult woman with long voluminous blonde curly hair, natural skin texture, and a subtle pout. She wears a beige ribbed cropped tank top and dark high-waisted leggings, holding a modern smartphone in a waist-up mirror reflection. The modern bathroom has neutral tiled walls, a chrome wall-mounted towel radiator, a white porcelain sink in the foreground, and an open doorway showing a hallway. Soft overhead indoor light, warm beige and cream tones, charcoal accents, realistic hair and skin detail, gentle background falloff, and polished everyday lifestyle realism.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh flash, broken reflection, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed, random text, watermark, low resolution, blur
